## CELL FACTS

Cell 木_食神 (Wood carrying The Artisan). Persona The Artisan (食神). Definition line: "Output that flows from you, giving that feels like being". Keyword Flow, charge gentle, poles catalyst Grace / friction Coasting. Family function: Expression. Cost dimension: giving that feels like being; worth tangled with what is made. Arena: craft, hands, the table, warmth of making, fed and feeding. Classical portrait: ease and appetite; output that flows without assertion; generous, content, prone to drift and indulgence. Ruled domains: Expression, Enjoyment, Children. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 伤官.
Element arena: Wood (trunk, branch, root, grain, growth, the forest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Water generating Wood same-polarity — depth as natural source of effortless reach".
- k2_overview: "Your Wood moves as the Artisan: growth that fruits. Everything you tend produces, gardens, projects, people, and the producing feels less like work than like season. You nourish by cultivating: patient feeding, honest pruning, harvests shared at the fence. Your gift ripens on its own schedule. Respect the schedule."
- k2_functional: "Your words grow on people slowly and stay. You persuade the way spring does."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Fruitful","Mellow","Tending"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Expression":"Your expression bears fruit: gardens, meals, projects that people can taste and hold. Make output a rhythm rather than an event. An orchard produces because producing is simply what it does.","Enjoyment":"You enjoy abundance in its natural forms: tables full, gardens loud, seasons honored with their own pleasures. Guard the fallow time too. Delight, like soil, needs its resting years.","Children":"You are patient with children and students. You feed them, give them space, and let them grow at their own speed rather than yours, and you enjoy the raising more than the results."}

- Sibling cell 木_伤官 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Free-growing","Original","Untamed"],"friction":["Chaotic","Sprawling","Defiant"]}
- Sibling cell 木_伤官 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Direction is your allergy. The plan says left, and something in you veers right on principle, even when left was your own idea last week. Paths bore you the moment they firm up, which keeps life interesting and keeps arrival permanently postponed."

Core element Water, energy element Wood. Law: Water feeds Wood (水生木: rain raises the forest). Relative to the core the energy is the fed, so Wood is this core's Expression. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Wood on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Wood as the Expression is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_木's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Coasting is how you move through most days. You finish what comes easily rather than what needs a push, since effort never felt like the point. Keep in mind that coasting carries you a long way and never quite to the finish.

value_b.text: You coast whenever the day lets you. Ease is what you trust, so you take the easy stretch instead of the hard one, even when you planned otherwise. Remember that coasting has never carried you anywhere you meant to go.

value.text: You coast on people who already like you. Since you feel safe with them, you give them the easy version instead of the effort you spend on strangers. Bear in mind that you give your least trying to those who love you most.

value.text: Saying no has never come easily to you. A no feels like going missing, so you say yes ahead of checking whether you have it to give. You know that each yes is paid by a later you who never agreed to it.

value_b.text: You say yes before the question is finished. Giving is how you know you are there, and that puts other people's needs ahead of your own supply. You were never asked to be the only one giving, and that is worth remembering.

value.text: Never saying no is how you stay loved. You would rather be tired than be the one who said no, so you run on less rest than anyone around you knows. Remember that you pay for every no you never say in sleep.

value.text: Comfort comes first with you. Because feeling good now is more real than feeling glad later, you take the soft option ahead of the one that pays off. What you put second to comfort is usually what you wanted most, and you know it.

value_b.text: You put comfort first and call it self care. You pick the pleasant choice ahead of the useful one, because the pleasant one asks nothing of you now. You know which of the two jobs you skip, comforting the body or keeping it strong.

value.text: Putting comfort first gets you through a hard week. Because the easy choice calms you now and the right one pays later, you take calm rather than right. You buy comfort with chances you cannot buy back, and that is the part to remember.

value.text: You put comfort first for those in your care too. Keeping a child happy now is easier than keeping them well later, so you pick pleasant hours over useful ones. You are choosing their later as well as their now, whatever it feels like today.
